integrity: Analytic singular-limit proof with standalone symbolic and high-precision reproduction; partial numerical checks are illustrative and not proofs of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Fast rectangular pulses of length epsilon times fixed scaled duration from baseline coexistence only; no result at the singular critical duration, no exact finite-epsilon threshold, no arbitrary initial-state or stochastic/ecological field claims.
title: A sharp duration–amplitude tipping boundary for temporary habitat shocks in a strong-Allee predator–prey system
